description_en: Queries for deep packet inspection (DPI) configuration errors
description_zh: 查询应用识别DPI（Deep Packet Inspection）配置异常的信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag list-dpi-config-error --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dpi-config-type qos --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDpiConfigError

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the regions and their IDs that Smart Access Gateway supports
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of instance for which the DPI feature is configured:

acl: a Resource Access Management instance.
qos: a QoS policy instance
parameters.help_zh:
配置了DPI功能的实例类型：

acl：表示访问控制实例。
qos：表示QoS策略实例
parameters.name: dpi_config_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance for which the DPI feature is configured
parameters.name: rule_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of configuration errors to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时允许每页展示的配置异常的最大条目数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

DpiConfigError.description_en: A list of DPI configuration errors

items.description_en: The information about a DPI configuration error

ErrorType.description_en:
The type of the configuration error.

DeviceNotSupported: The Smart Access Gateway device does not support the DPI feature.
VersionNotSupported: The DPI version of the Smart Access Gateway device is too old.
NotEnable: The DPI feature is disabled for the Smart Access Gateway device
ErrorType.description_zh:
配置异常类型。

**DeviceNotSupported **：智能接入网关设备不支持DPI功能。
**VersionNotSupported **：智能接入网关设备运行的DPI版本过低。
NotEnable：智能接入网关设备的DPI功能未开启

RuleConfigErrorList.description_en: A list of rule configuration errors

items.description_en: The information about a rule configuration error

DpiGroupIds.description_en: A list of IDs of application groups that have configuration errors
DpiGroupIds.description_zh: 配置异常的应用组ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of the application group that has a configuration error. You can call the [ListDpiGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html） operation to query application group IDs and the applications that are included in the application groups
items.description_zh:
配置异常的应用组ID。
您可以通过[ListDpiGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html）查询应用组ID及其包含的应用信息

DpiSignatureIds.description_en: A list of IDs of applications that have configuration errors

items.description_en:
The ID of the application that has a configuration error.

You can call the [ListDpiSignatures]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html） operation to query application IDs and information about the applications
items.description_zh:
配置异常的应用ID。

您可以通过[ListDpiSignatures]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html）查询应用ID及其对应的应用信息

RuleId.description_en:
The ID of the rule that is associated with the application that has a configuration error.

If you query DPI configuration errors for Resource Access Management, this parameter indicates the ID of the Resource Access Management rule instance that has a configuration error.
If you query DPI configuration errors for a QoS policy, this parameter indicates the ID of the quintuple rule instance that has a configuration error
RuleId.description_zh:
配置异常的应用关联的规则ID列表。

如果您当前查询的是访问控制DPI配置异常信息，则此处显示配置异常的访问控制规则实例ID。
如果您当前查询的是QoS策略DPI配置异常信息，则此处显示配置异常的五元组规则实例ID

SN.description_en: The serial number of the Smart Access Gateway device
SN.description_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of configuration errors to return on each page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时允许每页展示的配置异常的最大条目数

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page of results

Total.description_en: The total number of DPI configuration errors
